summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Expanded the direct public-company universe for the AI optical connectivity upstream node. The cleanest US-listed underfollowed exposures found in this pass are Veeco at the epitaxy/tool layer and AXT at the InP substrate layer. Coherent and Lumentum are included as reference optical/laser leaders because they sit closer to the visible AI datacenter optics demand and help validate whether upstream tool and wafer demand is truly AI-linked. This is a research universe only, not a buy/sell recommendation. Expanded the US-listed universe around the less visible upstream bottleneck below AI optical modules: InP/GaAs substrates, laser/photonic component manufacturing, compound-semiconductor deposition/etch tools, and precision subsystems used by tool OEMs. The cleanest underfollowed candidates for this pass are VECO and AXTI; MKSI is a broader second-order subsystem supplier; COHR is included as a reference anchor because it links AI datacenter optics, InP capacity, lasers, and transceivers. Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around the upstream optical-connectivity bottleneck. The strongest underfollowed fit is Veeco as a direct MOCVD/InP epitaxy-tool supplier for optical communications lasers. AXT is a substrate-level InP/GaAs wafer candidate tied to data-center connectivity but requires verification of AI/datacom mix, customer concentration, and supply-chain durability.
